newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary May PPI up 0.7 pct m/m, up 19.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary May PPI up 0.7 pct m/m, up 19.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Hungary's producer price index (PPI) showed a 0.7 percent rise month-on-month in May, and a 19.1 percent rise year-on-year, the central statistical office (KSH) said on Thursday.
The figures are final, and unchanged from the preliminary figures, released on July 3.
In May domestic sales prices rose 0.3 percent month-on-month and 19.3 percent year-on-year. Meanwhile export prices firmed 1.6 percent month-on-month and 18.7 percent year-on-year.
